title: Style findings are repaired without counting; leftovers become lint_* warnings

arguments.content:
---
title: Greet Almir by name
size: small
domains: [app]
---
Change the greeting in lib/greet.txt in order to name Almir.

## Acceptance
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains the line Hello, Almir!

## Verify
- A1: test

## Notes
Approach: replace the single line in lib/greet.txt with the new greeting text.

reply.text: {"rows": [{"constraint": "The greeting in lib/greet.txt says Hello, Almir!", "maps_to": "A1"}]}

write.text: Make the greeting in lib/greet.txt say Hello, Almir! instead of Hello!

expect.stderr_regex: (?s)(?m)^shaper pass=1 role=shaper style_repair$.*^shaper pass=1 role=shaper style_repair$

$contains.message: Brief contains banned phrase "in order to"

notes: The style-repair message text is not specified; the case only relies on the turn count (2 style repairs per conversation) and the leftover warning.
